name: Ore-sama Teacher ~Fukushuu Kyoushi no Web Counseling~
original_name: オレ様ティーチャー～復讐教師のWebカウンセリング～
source:
Main character is a teacher at a boarding school at daytime, but in his leisure time he runs a website for troubled women. Both rebellious and diligent female students there have their secrets. They expose them on the website without knowing what kind of insulting evil approaches them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角白天是寄宿學校的教師，閒暇時則經營一個幫有煩惱的女性排憂解惑的網站。學校裡的叛逆女學生與勤奮女學生都有自己的秘密。她們在不知情的情況下，將秘密暴露在網站上，任由侮辱性的邪惡手段找上門來。

（來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]）
